newsitem.title: IRAN: Iran holds funeral for 750 war dead.
newsitem.headline: Iran holds funeral for 750 war dead.

text.p: Iran held a mass funeral on Wednesday for 750 soldiers killed in its 1980-88 war with Iraq whose bodies were recently found in former war zones.
Coffins of the dead soldiers, wrapped in Iranian flags, were carried on trailers through a crowd of 10,000 people as helicopters showered the scene with flowers.
Iran's supreme leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei, parliament speaker Ali Akbar Nateq-Nouri, and a number of deputies attended the ceremony in front of parliament in central Tehran.
The remains of 27,700 Iranian soldiers missing in action have been found and identified since the end of the war, the daily Iran quoted a military official as saying.
An estimated one million Iranians and Iraqis were killed in the war, according to Western sources.
